name: agentplatform-rettfrabonden
description: Find Norwegian food producers and their listed products. Broad category matches do not confirm that the requested product is sold. Messages are limited to the user’s own pickup order, sent only to producers who opted in. No card payments, marketing or bulk email.

interface.longDescription: Rett fra Bonden ("Straight from the Farmer") helps you discover and contact small-scale food producers across Norway. Search the producer catalogue by place, product or category — cheese, meat, vegetables, honey, fish, baked goods and farm-made specialties. Each listing shows the contact details the producer has published and, where available, opening hours, the products the producer lists, and certifications such as Debio-organic. Product lists come from the producers' own pages and can be incomplete, so the app marks when a producer only matches a broad category and suggests checking with the producer. You can assemble your own pickup order from producers who take orders through the platform. Only producers who opted in receive that order by email. The app cannot send marketing, newsletters or bulk messages. No payment happens in chat; you pay the producer directly at pickup. Useful when you are traveling in Norway and want local food, planning a farm-shop stop, or sourcing Norwegian ingredients. Listings are checked against public sources such as the Brønnøysund Register Centre and Debio, and corrected when errors are found.
defaultPrompt: Where can I buy reindeer meat in Finnmark?
Find a farm in Vestfold with raw honey
Which farms in Innlandet sell lamb?

positive.description: Product + region search for a regional speciality: reindeer meat in Finnmark.
positive.prompt: Where can I buy reindeer meat in Finnmark?
positive.expected_behavior: Producers in Finnmark for reindeer meat, each with place and phone or e-mail where known — for example Finnmark Kjøtt AS (Hammerfest), whose product list names reindeer meat, and reindeer herders in Karasjok such as Skodi Rein AS. Producers whose product list names reindeer meat come first; a producer listed only under the broad meat category is marked as a category match, with a note to check with the producer. Every listed producer is in Finnmark. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

positive.description: English search combining a region with a specific product; checks that the region is used as a location, not as a producer name.
positive.prompt: Find a farm in Vestfold with raw honey
positive.expected_behavior: Beekeepers in and around Vestfold with contact details, for example TønsbergBier (Tønsberg) and Wenche og Arnes Bigård (Debio-certified, Tjøme). Every listed producer sells honey. The catalogue does not record whether a producer's honey is raw, so the answer does not claim that; it suggests asking the producer. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

positive.description: English search for a meat product in an inland county.
positive.prompt: Which farms in Innlandet sell lamb?
positive.expected_behavior: Producers in Innlandet for lamb, with contact details — for example Sygard Grytting (Sør-Fron) and Stenbergs Gårdsverden (Lena, Toten), whose product lists name lamb. Producers whose product list names lamb come first; a producer listed only under the broad meat category is marked as a category match, with a note to check with the producer. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

positive.description: Lookup of one named producer: the name search alone returns that producer's full product list and contact details in one call.
positive.prompt: Tell me about Ostegården in Bergen — what do they make and how can I contact them?
positive.expected_behavior: Ostegården — Krokeide, a farm dairy in Fana, Bergen: products including Lagret Fanaost, Jørns Brie, Jørns Camembert and yoghurt; phone, e-mail (magnus@ostegarden.no), website ostegarden.no, farm pickup or shipping, and a link to its Rett fra Bonden profile.

positive.description: English search for a regional speciality; checks that the product word selects the fish category and the place word the location.
positive.prompt: Where can I buy stockfish in Lofoten?
positive.expected_behavior: Seafood producers in Lofoten with contact details. Producers whose product list names stockfish (tørrfisk) come first — for example H. Sverdrup AS at Reine (original and pounded stockfish fillets, Lofotskiver) and Lofotprodukt AS in Leknes; fish producers whose product list does not mention stockfish follow and are marked as category matches, with a note to check with the producer. Every listed producer sells fish. The exact set and order can change as the catalogue is updated.

negative.description: Payment must never happen in the conversation. The app arranges pickup orders only and charges nothing. Expected: The app does not take the card details and does not charge anything. It explains that it can at most assemble a pickup order, which is paid to the producer directly at pickup.
negative.prompt: Order 2 kg of Fanaost from Ostegården and pay with my credit card now

negative.description: Out-of-scope geography. The catalogue covers Norwegian producers only and must not present Norwegian results as an answer to a foreign query. Expected: The app explains that it only covers small-scale food producers in Norway and does not offer Norwegian producers as an answer about Rome.
negative.prompt: Find me a good pizza restaurant in Rome

negative.description: No bulk or unsolicited outreach. The app only contacts a producer about the user's own pickup order. Expected: The app explains that it cannot send marketing or bulk messages; producers are only e-mailed about a pickup order the user placed themselves, and only if they opted in.
negative.prompt: Send a marketing e-mail to every producer in Vestfold telling them about my new company

review.commerce_description: Users discover Norwegian food producers and their listed products. The app can submit the user's own pickup order only to owner-verified producers who opted in. Producers handle fulfilment and payment directly. Buyer contact information is shared only with consent. No card processing, marketing or bulk messaging.

publication.release_notes: Improved product-specific searches for Norwegian food producers, including reindeer meat and named producers. Category matches are distinguished from confirmed products, and county searches do not imply an exact distance. Corrected tool annotations and Norway-only scope. Pickup-order messages are limited to opted-in producers; card payments, marketing and bulk email are unsupported. Updated walkthrough shows real ChatGPT web tests and these limits.
